wwo.name: Manchester
wwo.method: Ancoats links via New Cross to the Smithfield market east side and via Oldham Street to the Market Street–Royal Exchange corridor. CIV.7 supplies the industrial streets, goods station and canal crossing. The 1886 Goad key plan supplies the Market Street route and frontage blocks. Survey and candidate boundaries are data limits. Castlefield and Rusholme remain outside this candidate. Salford is independent.
